note: A native partition guards its complete column set; drift withholds the family. The exact issue list comes from test_source_scope_partitions.py's stale-partition test: the stale partition plus the withheld unsplit family's unresolved_catalog_identity, and nothing else (the old test's target_projection_changed is how a stored case reported the staleness; a build reports it at compile as this case's stale_curation_entry).
fails_if: `_column_partition_plan` accepts a declared column map that is a superset of the delivered columns, so the partition naming NEW still applies when only OLD is delivered; or the compile stops mapping the stale partition's base to an explicit unresolved provider key, so the unsplit family is formed (or the build aborts) instead of reporting unresolved_catalog_identity
